desktopLayout.tip.search.description: Find layouts by name or save time.

desktopLayout.tip.newFolder.description: Create a folder that only groups layouts and stores no icon positions, for example "PC A". Then drag layouts such as "Laptop" or "External Monitor" into it.
desktopLayout.tip.newFolder.suggestion: Select the folder, then click Save Icon Layout, and new layouts go straight into it.

desktopLayout.tip.editorHelp.short: Drag icons to adjust positions; releasing snaps them to the grid. Shift+drag empty space to pan, scroll to zoom.
desktopLayout.tip.editorHelp.detail: Drag icons to adjust positions; releasing snaps them to the saved layout's grid, and an occupied target slot falls back to the nearest free slot. Shift+drag empty space pans the canvas; the wheel zooms. The top buttons zoom out, zoom in and fit to window. Long-press New Icons to drag the panel; it changes its expand direction near a page edge. New icons can be dragged onto the desktop, and desktop icons can be dragged back into New Icons. A green outline marks a new icon; a red outline marks a deleted/missing icon. Finish and Save only writes to the layout folder and does not move the current desktop; switch to the matching monitors and click Restore Now on the layout card to apply it.
desktopLayout.tip.scanDeleted.descriptio: Compare with the current desktop again and list icons that the layout has but the desktop can no longer find.
desktopLayout.tip.scanDeleted.suggestion: Saving the editor removes these icons from the layout automatically; this button only compares and reports.
desktopLayout.tip.zoomOut.name: Zoom out the preview desktop
desktopLayout.tip.zoomOut.description: Shrink the preview desktop one step to see the whole picture.
desktopLayout.tip.zoomIn.name: Zoom in the preview desktop
desktopLayout.tip.zoomIn.description: Enlarge the preview desktop one step to line up icons.
desktopLayout.tip.fitWindow.description: Fit the whole preview desktop inside the editor window.
desktopLayout.tip.cancelEdit.name: Cancel editing
desktopLayout.tip.cancelEdit.description: Do not save the position changes made in this editor.
desktopLayout.tip.finishSave.description: Saves only to the layout folder and does not move the current desktop; switch to the matching monitors and click Restore Now on the layout card to apply it.
desktopLayout.tip.finishSave.suggestion: It is fine if the current monitors differ from the saved ones; saving never moves icons on the current screen.
desktopLayout.tip.newIconTag.description: Click to expand/collapse; long-press and drag to move the whole panel; drag desktop icons into this box to move them into New Icons.
desktopLayout.tip.newIconTag.suggestion: The panel changes its expand direction at the page edge; icons moved into New Icons are arranged into the default free slots when saving.

desktopLayout.tip.newIconFilter.descript: Type a name to search new icons
desktopLayout.tip.missingIcon.descriptio: This icon no longer exists on the desktop; right-click to remove it from the preview desktop, and Finish and Save also removes it automatically.
desktopLayout.tip.missingIcon.suggestion: Right-click → Remove from preview desktop (the real file on this PC is not deleted).
desktopLayout.tip.newIconScroll.descript: Scroll the New Icons card strip left or right.
